mostWorthwhile.text: Following trapped particles toward the throat and then seeing a macrophage engulf a microbe made the two airway defenses concrete in the planned cutaways.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the moving lining to the body added less explanation than the defense mechanisms themselves, though the compatibility feedback made the required order clear.

arbitrary.text: The requirement to attach the lining to the body before adding macrophages was not obvious from their pictured roles, though the feedback resolved it.

continue.text: I would continue: the successive cutaway plans connect structures to functions clearly, although the largely predictable combinations leave limited scope for decisions.
